This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]. The [[humanoid]] species was distinguished by their large, hairless [[Bone|craniums]], with solid [[Color|dark]] [[eye]]s, pronounced brows, overlapping, folded cheeks, ribbed chins, small [[mouth]]s, and a lack of visible [[ear]]s or [[Nose|nostrils]].<ref name="Fort Ypso" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="SoloDate">{{FilmDate|Solo}}</ref> a member of this species gambled at [[Fort Ypso]] on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]].<ref name="Fort Ypso" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species was first shown in the featurette "[[Scoundrels, Droids, Creatures and Cards: Welcome to Fort Ypso]]" that accompanied the [[Star Wars home video releases#Solo: A Star Wars Story|home release]] of the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', where it was included among a maquette display of the gambling segment at Fort Ypso on Vandor,<ref name="Fort Ypso" /> though unlike the rest of the aliens in this display, this particular species never appeared within the final cut of the film.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
